exact_statement: For fixed q in Q^bd and m0 in (0,1), under Assumption 4.1, v_hat_alpha converges almost surely to sigma_bd^2 as alpha decreases to zero; for every gamma in (0,1), the same-path plug-in interval covers 1/KL_inf(q,m0) with limiting probability 1-gamma.

tested_instance.assumption_4_1: Satisfied: q has endpoint atoms and bounded support {0,1}; mean 0.6 differs from m0.

acceptance.largest_b_coverage: Both 0.95 and 0.50 lie in their respective 95% Wilson intervals.
acceptance.largest_b_vhat_ratio: Mean and median v_hat/sigma_bd^2 are each in [0.97,1.03].
acceptance.largest_b_centering: Absolute relative centering error is at most 0.003.
acceptance.trends: Median and 90th-percentile absolute v_hat errors improve, and both coverage errors improve, from the first to the last scale.
acceptance.controls: The finite-alpha large-scale gate and the wrong KL_inf^2 denominator must fail.

verdict_scope: A direct, full Monte Carlo verification of the exact Proposition 4.5 construction for a nondegenerate Bernoulli law. It is not a proof over every q in Q^bd.
